responsibility: Implements forward propagation of single-use expressions and related local simplifications in SSA GIMPLE. The pass pushes RHS expressions, casts, address expressions, comparisons, vector permutations, and selected builtins into their uses—especially conditionals and switches—using a simple const/copy lattice and repeated local folding, with the goal of exposing simpler conditions, direct memory references, and dead temporaries while updating EH and noreturn CFG effects created by the rewritten statements.
